intro.title: A Complete Destination for Living & Business
intro.p1: Advait Skyline brings an unprecedented architectural benchmark to the Naroli–Bhilad corridor. Designed by Takshashila Architects and engineered for IS-standard seismic safety, this G+14 mixed-use landmark fuses high-street retail vitality with quiet residential serenity.
intro.p2: Positioned just 200 meters from the Naroli–Bhilad Checkpost along the bustling Naroli–Silvassa main road, residents enjoy seamless transit between Gujarat and Dadra & Nagar Haveli alongside 39+ world-class amenities.

faq.title: Everything You Need to Know About Advait Skyline
faq.a1: Advait Skyline is located on the Naroli–Silvassa main road, approximately 200 meters from the Naroli–Bhilad Checkpost in Vadfaliya, Dadra & Nagar Haveli – 396235.
faq.q2: Who is the developer of Advait Skyline?
faq.a2: Advait Skyline is developed by Dhanasvi Infra, a reputable real estate partnership firm dedicated to premium construction quality and timely delivery in the Dadra & Nagar Haveli region.
faq.q3: What unit configurations are offered at Advait Skyline?
faq.a3: The development offers premium 1 BHK and 2 BHK residential apartments, along with ground-floor retail shops (Shops 1–20), 1st-floor commercial spaces, and 2nd-floor offices.
faq.q4: How many amenities are available in the project?
faq.a4: Advait Skyline features an extensive collection of 39+ lifestyle amenities, including a swimming pool, separate gyms for men and women, club house, mini theater, basketball court, box cricket, and 24×7 CCTV surveillance.
faq.q5: What is the RERA registration number for Advait Skyline?
faq.a5: Advait Skyline is registered under RERA registration number PM3000002600013. Verification details can be reviewed via the official regulatory portal.
faq.q6: What is the carpet area of the 1 BHK flats?
faq.a6: The 1 BHK apartments feature a thoughtful carpet area of approximately 511 sq. ft. (47.47 sq. m.) with a spacious living room, private balcony, 2 bathrooms, and a modern kitchen.
faq.q7: What is the carpet area of the 2 BHK flats?
faq.a7: The 2 BHK residences feature an expansive carpet area of approximately 573 sq. ft. (53.23 sq. m.) with two generous bedrooms, a 16-foot living hall, a 5'6" wide sunset balcony, and 2 bathrooms.
faq.q8: How can I book a site visit to Advait Skyline?
faq.a8: You can schedule a site visit instantly by clicking the 'Book a Site Visit' button, sending a message on WhatsApp at +91 99090 72390, or calling our sales office directly at +91 99090 72363.
faq.q9: Is Naroli (Dadra & Nagar Haveli) the same as Narol in Ahmedabad?
faq.a9: No. Naroli is an industrial and residential hub in the Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli, situated near Bhilad and roughly 10 km from Silvassa. Narol is a separate locality in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. Advait Skyline is located specifically in Naroli, Dadra & Nagar Haveli (PIN 396235).
faq.q10: How far is Advait Skyline from Silvassa?
faq.a10: Advait Skyline is located approximately 10 km from central Silvassa (about 13 to 15 minutes by car along the Naroli–Silvassa main road). The project is positioned 200 meters from the Naroli–Bhilad Checkpost, offering direct connectivity between Silvassa and Bhilad Railway Station.
